name: block-secret-store-reads
description: Best-effort guard against an agent reading credentials from the shell: cat, cp, tar, source or < on ~/.ssh (not .pub), ~/.aws, ~/.npmrc, agent CLI dirs, browser DBs, wallets, .env, *.tfstate; interpreter one-liners naming them; token printers (gh auth token, aws sts); curl, wget or iwr to cloud metadata credential paths (169.254.169.254, 169.254.170.2, GCE). Asks on env dumps. Misses: scripts, unresolved variables, xargs lists, $(...) results, metadata reached by DNS name, proxy or SDK. [Session-enforced via a PreToolUse hook; needs git, a usable bash and a Python 3.11+ (python3, python or py, whichever actually runs; the Windows Store stub is skipped). With no working Python the hook refuses (exit 2); without git or bash, fail-open clients allow silently and fail-closed clients refuse matched commands. If the guard itself crashes or times out, the hook asks for confirmation rather than allowing silently.]
